# Turkey Coach Montella Praises Arda Guler’s Talent Ahead of World Cup Clash
[...]
Turkey head coach Vincenzo Montella has praised Arda Guler for his exceptional skills and game intelligence ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 match against Australia. Guler, 21, will lead Turkey's attack as they return to the World Cup finals for the first time since 2002. Montella highlighted Guler's ability to handle pressure and read the game, though fitness concerns remain after a hamstring injury. Turkey faces an experienced Australian side that reached the last 16 of the 2022 World Cup.
[...]
has talent": Turkey coach Vincenzo Montella praises Arda Guler
[...]
Ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 match against Australia, Turkey head coach Vincenzo Montella lauded one of his key players, Arda Guler, for his exceptional skills and game intelligence.
[...]
Montella said, as quoted by Reuters, "He has talent, intuition, reading of the game; he knows when to slow down, when to go vertical, and he knows how to score. He has an innocent face, but he is very clever."
[...]
Guler is set to spearhead a determined Turkey team as they return to the World Cup finals for the first time in over 20 years, facing an energetic Australia in their Group D opener at Vancouver's BC Place on Saturday.
[...]
Although Turkey have delivered strong performances in recent European Championships, they have not featured in a World Cup since reaching the semi-finals in 2002. Born long after that campaign, 21-year-old Guler now carries the attacking ambitions of his football-passionate nation.
[...]
The Turkey head coach further praised the star midfielder's performance under pressure, adding, "He has talent, plays at a high level, and handles a lot of pressure."
[...]
Although Guler may be capable of handling the responsibility, concerns remain over his fitness following a hamstring injury sustained late in the club season with Real Madrid, which forced him to miss the season's final matches, Reuters reported.
[...]
His recent appearances against North Macedonia and Venezuela eased some of those concerns, but Guler faces a challenging task as Turkey takes on an Australian side that reached the last 16 of the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, where they were eliminated by eventual champions Argentina.

results.title: 'They may be afraid of us' Orkun Kokcu and Kerem Akturkoglu's World Cup words!
highlights:
## National Team footballers Kerem Aktürkoğlu and Orkun Kökçü made important statements about the World Cup at the press conference.
[...]
Ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, Orkun Kökçü and Kerem Aktürkoğlu answered questions at the press conference.
[...]
Kerem Aktürkoğlu: It is a beautiful camp. We are aware that our whole country is waiting for this moment. I am not injured, thank God we are over it. We are also aware of what is expected of us. We are preparing in the best way. I hope it will be a very good tournament for our country. We want to represent our country as a team and as a game. We are here after 24 years, we grew up with the stories of our older brothers being third in the world. It was the dream of all of us. It is a great pride to have achieved this, to have the opportunity to represent our country in the World Cup. Just coming here and participating should not be an achievement for a country like ours. After the European Championship, we are here with our football and as a team we reflect our own character and football on the field in every way. And this reflects positively on the results. He came to this tournament with a very good form graph.
[...]
Orkun Kökçü: "The atmosphere of friends is like a family atmosphere, we are very good. Everyone gets along well. This is reflected in the training. We are preparing in a very fun way. We are ready. We will prepare even better. We are looking forward to the first match. You hear the stories of 2002; my father, my uncles tell them. Of course I couldn't experience it, we participated in the tournament 24 years later. Because I was born and raised in the Netherlands, in 2010 the Netherlands reached the final, I saw the excitement there. I was dreaming that one day I would hopefully experience this with Turkey. Now we are on this stage. I hope we can experience it too. I agree that they see us as a 'dark horse', as a team we are full of quality players. We have players who can do something extra at any moment. They might be afraid of us!"
[...]
Kerem Aktürkoğlu said the following about Kenan: "We all know Kenan's quality. He is very important for us. As far as I know, his injury is getting better, he started training. I don't know the timing of his return as we are not doctors. I sincerely say that we have very good players, young and with potential. We are all aware of that. I hope Kenan will be with us in every game and make important contributions. It doesn't really matter who plays, 85 million people will be behind him no matter who plays. I hope everyone will be fit and ready to play."

results.title: "They Can Be Afraid of Us" – Kökçü and Aktürkoğlu Signal Bold World Cup Ambitions for Turkey - Turkish Football
highlights:
Speaking from Turkey’s pre-tournament training camp in Arizona, national team stars Orkun Kökçü and Kerem Aktürkoğlu delivered a confident message to their upcoming rivals, asserting that the Crescent-Stars are ready to disrupt the status quo at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
[...]
The press conference marks a historic moment for Turkish football, as the nation prepares to make its first World Cup appearance in 24 years. Turkey famously secured its tournament ticket in April following a dramatic 1-0 play-off final victory over Kosovo—a decisive goal scored by Aktürkoğlu off a Kökçü assist.
[...]
Midfielder Orkun Kökçü did not shy away from the high expectations surrounding the squad, fully embracing the notion that Turkey could surprise the world’s elite footballing nations.
[...]
“I agree with those who view us as a ‘dark horse’ in this tournament,” Kökçü told reporters. “Our squad is packed with top-tier, quality players. We have individuals capable of producing a moment of magic out of nowhere at any given second. Quite frankly, they can be afraid of us.”
[...]
Winger-turned-forward Kerem Aktürkoğlu provided a major boost for head coach Vincenzo Montella, confirming he has completely recovered from a recent injury scare sustained during early preparations in Istanbul.
[...]
“There is no injury anymore, thank God we’ve moved past it,” Aktürkoğlu said. “We are acutely aware of what the entire country expects from us. Simply qualifying shouldn’t be considered the ultimate success for a nation like ours. We want to showcase our footballing identity on the world stage.”
[...]
Addressing his tactical role under Montella, the 27-year-old noted that while he is naturally a winger, he is completely comfortable leading the line up front for the national team. “I have no complaints; I feel great. The most important thing is contributing to the team, and I feel highly effective in the forward position.”
[...]
The duo, who both play their club football for Portuguese giants Benfica, highlighted the tight-knit family atmosphere within the current Turkish squad. Having already spent significant time in the United States last year for the FIFA Club World Cup with Benfica, they noted that adjusting to the intense Arizona heat hasn’t dampened the team’s spirits.
[...]
“We are preparing in a highly focused yet enjoyable environment,” Kökçü added, praising Aktürkoğlu’s seamless transition since moving to Lisbon. “We’ve built an incredible understanding both on and off the pitch. But the ultimate story is the one we want to write right here at the World Cup.”

results.title: 2026 World Cup Group D Analysis: Turkey's greatest strength is unpredictability
highlights:
## Turkish National Football Team returns to the World Cup stage after a 24-year hiatus. We have analyzed our Crescent-Stars and their opponents who will compete in Group D for you. Here are the details...
[...]
TURKEYTurkey reached the 2026 World Cup through Group E of the European Qualifiers after 24 years. Finishing the group in second place, three points behind Spain, the Crescent-Stars booked their World Cup ticket by defeating Romania in the play-off semifinals and Kosovo in the final.
[...]
KEY PLAYERS AND MANAGERSTURKEYArda Güler stands out as the most important figure for our National Football Team. Alongside Kenan Yıldız, who has enjoyed an excellent season at Juventus, Barış Alper Yılmaz, Can Uzun, and Uğurcan Çakır—who have all successfully drawn attention both in the Süper Lig and the Champions League—are highlighted as crucial players for the squad. Head coach Vincenzo Montella has been leading the team for a long time and shares a very strong bond with the players.
[...]
TACTICAL FORMATIONSTURKEYTurkey generally sets up in a 4-1-3-2 formation on the pitch. However, manager Vincenzo Montella is a tactician who implements different options from time to time. The most critical point lies in the forward line. The Italian coach occasionally utilizes Kerem Aktürkoğlu as a false 9. He mostly makes choices based on the opponent.
[...]

[...]
